Changes to the spektrafilm material in this folder (CC BY-SA 4.0)
=================================================================

2026-11-05  选片工具 (https://github.com/Ly-star-bit/photo_culling)
  Each .cube here was generated with spektrafilm 0.3.4 (Andrea Volpato,
  https://github.com/andreavolpato/spektrafilm) from one film profile and one print
  profile (reversal films scanned directly). Changes from a full spektrafilm render:
  - baked as a 32^3 3D LUT, sRGB gamma-encoded input and output;
  - per-pixel part only (spektrafilm debug.lut_mode): no grain, halation, coupler
    diffusion, glare, blur or sharpening; auto exposure off;
  - exposure fixed at mid gray (no auto exposure); before the film, log2 exposure
    around mid gray is scaled by 0.8 below and 1.5 above (an
    inverse of the camera tone curve already in the photo; reversal films 1.2 above);
    scanner white / black point correction on;
  - per look (since 2026-11-05, see RECIPES in the script): print paper contrast
    (density curve morph gamma), DIR coupler amount, scanner black level and
    enlarger Y / M filtration changed from the spektrafilm defaults; one film changed
    (filmSunny now Kodak UltraMax 400 instead of Gold 200);
  - after spektrafilm, an output-only "scan correction" (scan_correct in the script:
    white / black point, cool shadows and warm highlights on near-neutrals, skin /
    green / blue hue and chroma, saturation) is applied to the look table and to the
    print table below, so grain stays consistent with the look;
  - renamed with generic look names (file name = look id in the app);
  - <look>.film.cube / <look>.print.cube: the same chain split at the film density
    (spektrafilm's cmy_film tap) into two 24^3 tables, so the app can add grain
    between them; <look>.json: the density range of that split, the per-channel grain
    standard deviation derived from spektrafilm's grain model, and its halation preset.
  The app blends each table toward the original with its strength slider at run time.
  Script: culling-poc/LabelGUI/Scripts/bake_film_luts.py
